headline: Pulisic signs new AC Milan contract through 2031
facts: Pulisic, 28, extended his Milan deal to 2031; the old contract ran to June 2027.
He has 44 goals and 28 assists in 141 Serie A games and played at both the 2022 and 2026 World Cups.
He called this the most important chapter of his career and said Milan feels like home.
background: Milan signed Pulisic from Chelsea in 2023 for about 22m euros, after he won the 2021 Champions League with Chelsea.

headline: Milan and Inter sign 20-year Generali naming deal for new San Siro stadium
facts: Sources put the 20-year naming rights deal at about 650m euros (around 725m dollars).
The planned 71,500-seat Generali Stadium targets a first match in the 2031-32 season, with construction starting in 2028.
The clubs bought the site for about 197m euros last November, clearing the way to demolish the old San Siro.
background: San Siro dates to 1926 and was renovated for the 1990 World Cup; Italy co-hosts Euro 2032 with Turkiye and must upgrade its stadiums.
footage_terms: San Siro new stadium Generali render

headline: Mussolini's great-grandson scores first Serie A goal as Lazio hit Sassuolo for six
facts: Lazio beat Sassuolo 6-2; Romano Floriani Mussolini, 23, scored in the 16th minute for the third goal.
The goal was first flagged offside, then allowed after a video review.
It was his first Serie A goal and only the second of his career; his first came in Serie B on loan at Juve Stabia.
background: He is the great-grandson of Benito Mussolini, who ruled Italy from 1922 to 1943; his mother Alessandra Mussolini is a former European Parliament member, and he says he has no interest in politics.

headline: Napoli coach Allegri banned for two games after insulting officials in 3-3 draw with Roma
facts: Allegri got a two-match touchline ban and a 10,000 euro fine after being sent off late in the 3-3 home draw with Roma.
Lega Serie A cited an insulting remark to officials and aggressive behaviour toward a Roma staff member; Allegri denies speaking to the fourth official.
Napoli first said they would appeal, but Allegri decided not to; he misses the Monza and Juventus away games and joked the ban could grow to four.
background: Allegri won five straight Scudetti in his first spell at Juventus; he took over Napoli after Antonio Conte left by mutual consent.

headline: Bologna beat Milan 4-2 as Mbangula hits a hat-trick, Amorim's first Serie A loss
facts: Mbangula scored three times for Bologna; Milan's Bartesaghi added an own goal; Cisse scored twice for Milan.
It was Bologna's first Serie A win at San Siro in more than 10 years.
The defeat was Amorim's first Serie A loss at Milan and dropped Milan from first to fourth with 24 points.
background: Amorim arrived at Milan after leaving Manchester United; Milan had lost only once in the league before this game.

headline: Milan beat Inter 3-1 in the derby, ending Inter's unbeaten run
facts: Pulisic and Rabiot scored early and Moreira added a late free kick; Bastoni scored Inter's goal from a corner.
VAR overturned a possible Inter penalty after the ball hit a Milan defender's midsection.
Lazio took first place after the result; Inter dropped to second, one point back, and Milan are unbeaten in five derbies.
background: The match drew 77,691 fans, the biggest Serie A crowd of the season so far; Inter had gone nine league games unbeaten.

headline: Juventus beat ten-man Napoli 2-0 to ease pressure on Spalletti
facts: Alajbegovic scored from long range in the 70th minute and substitute Boga added a late second.
Napoli's Marianucci was sent off for a second yellow card in the 75th minute.
Napoli suffered a fourth league defeat of the season and sat 10th; Juventus had won only one of their previous four league games.
background: Napoli's coach Allegri is a former Juventus coach, and Spalletti is the coach who won Napoli's first Scudetti since Maradona's era.

headline: Amorim slams Milan after 2-0 Europa League loss to Ferencvaros and questions himself
facts: Milan lost 2-0 at home to Ferencvaros; both goals came within 14 minutes after half-time, the first after a mistake by backup keeper Lorenzo Torriani.
Amorim said Milan had no excuses and questioned his own preparation; he said the team is not yet ready to play Serie A and Europe at the same time.
Milan have three points from four league-phase games and sit 28th.
background: Amorim is a former Manchester United manager; he made six changes from the side that had just beaten Inter in the derby.
footage_terms: Amorim press conference Milan Europa League

headline: Nico Paz takes Argentina's No. 10 shirt after Messi retires from international football
facts: Messi has retired from international football, and Como's Nico Paz inherits the Argentina No. 10 shirt.
ESPN says Paz is not a like-for-like Messi replacement: taller, less explosive, and a right winger for Argentina right now.
Paz has 25 goals and 25 assists in 89 games for Como; his high shot volume this season comes with lower accuracy.
background: Paz came through Real Madrid's youth system, joined Como in August 2024 for about 6m euros, and grew under first-time senior coach Cesc Fabregas.
footage_terms: Nico Paz Champions League Como Leipzig

headline: Real Madrid reportedly set to trigger 80m euro Nico Paz buy-back in 2027
facts: A Spanish radio report says Madrid have already decided to use the 80m euro buy-back option; it is valid only in summer 2027.
Como paid an extra 60m euros this summer to cancel a 50 percent sell-on clause, and the new deal added the 80m option.
Paz has 6 goals and 8 assists in 14 club games this season; neither club has confirmed the report.
background: Como signed Paz in 2024 for 6m euros with Madrid keeping a sell-on clause and cheap buy-back options.

headline: Monaco offer Folarin Balogun to Milan and Juventus ahead of January
facts: Per Calciomercato, Monaco have offered the 25-year-old USMNT striker to Milan and Juventus; his agent Jorge Mendes has contacted both.
A 40m euro move to Everton collapsed at the end of the last window.
Balogun is under contract at Monaco until June 2028 and is reportedly open to Serie A.
background: This is a rumour-column item from ESPN; neither club has confirmed interest.

headline: Malen is Europe's top scorer in 2026 and is transformed at Roma
facts: Malen scored 14 goals in 18 Serie A games on loan last season and has 8 in 8 this season, including a hat-trick against Fiorentina.
Sky counts 18 open-play goals for him in 2026, four more than any other player in Europe's big leagues.
Gasperini plays him as a centre-forward and compared him to Gianluca Vialli, admitting he did not expect such numbers.
background: Malen came through at Arsenal, was prolific at PSV, then returned only sporadic goals at Dortmund and was never settled at Aston Villa.

headline: Man Utd come from two goals down to beat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford
facts: Roma led 2-0 at half-time, with a Malen penalty for the second goal.
Cunha scored twice late, the equaliser after a poor Balerdi clearance, and was then sent off; Fernandes scored from a retaken penalty.
The win ended a long winless run for United; Fernandes said he accepted his recent benching.
background: Roma came into the game unbeaten in Serie A; a source inconsistency exists over who scored Roma's first goal.

headline: Kean out for months as Como striker's bone problem flares again
facts: Fabregas confirmed Kean will be out for several months after a new scare in which he was taken away by ambulance.
The recurring right leg bone issue goes back to last season; surgery may be the only option.
Kean has not played since 20 September, and Como may need another striker because Douvikas is the only available centre-forward.
background: Kean's tibia problems were reportedly behind a failed Atletico Madrid medical in 2023/24.

headline: Napoli keeper Meret fractures a vertebra in training before Torino game
facts: Tests confirmed a fracture of the fifth lumbar vertebra after a training incident.
The club said Meret has begun rehabilitation but gave no return date; Italian papers talk of about two months.
Napoli are 10th with 15 points, 14 behind leaders Lazio, and Allegri already lacks Di Lorenzo, Spinazzola, Lobotka, Neres and others.
background: Milinkovic-Savic started the 1-1 draw with Lazio before the break and is likely to keep the place.

headline: Italy lose 4-1 in Belgium and miss the Nations League quarter-finals
facts: Italy lost 4-1 away to Belgium and fell from first to third in their group.
A draw would have been enough to reach the quarter-finals; Italy had beaten France 3-1 at San Siro in the previous round.
Their next competitive games are Euro 2028 qualifiers from 22 March 2027.
background: Italy are seeded for the Euro 2028 qualifying draw, held in Belfast on 6 December.

headline: Milan ready to sell Estupinan and Loftus-Cheek and loan out young players in January
facts: Amorim reportedly regrets keeping Estupinan after an Aston Villa move was nearly agreed; Villa are no longer interested and a Fiorentina loan is possible.
Loftus-Cheek's contract ends this season and injuries and poor form make a January sale likely.
Camarda and Christian Comotto are expected to go out on loan; no fees or wages are reported.
background: Milan have lost three of four Europa League games and there is a big gap between the first XI and the rotation squad.

headline: Mourinho wants to keep Endrick at Real Madrid as Milan and Roma circle
facts: Mourinho coaches Real Madrid and says he values Endrick but the decision may rest with club management.
Milan are reportedly ready to pay about 60m euros in January; Roma are interested in a loan.
Milan are also looking at Club Brugge's Nicolo Tresoldi and Stuttgart's Ermedin Demirovic.
background: Endrick is a Brazilian forward at Real Madrid; this is a reported interest, not a confirmed bid.

headline: Conte says he left Inter after the 2021 title because of a broken plan and wants to return to Juventus one day
facts: In an interview Conte said Inter hired him in 2019 to end Juventus' dominance after Juventus chose Sarri instead of taking him back.
After the 2020-21 title he was told nearly any player could be sold; he felt the plan was broken and left, and Lukaku and Hakimi were sold afterwards.
He said he would like to return to Juventus one day to close the cycle.
background: Conte won the 2020-21 Serie A title with Inter and later coached Napoli before leaving by mutual consent this year.

headline: Monza striker Gustavo Varela leads Serie A scoring and has top clubs queuing
facts: Varela leads Serie A with nine goals even though Monza sit in the relegation zone.
He received his first Portugal call-up this month.
Tottenham have enquired, Liverpool watch him weekly, and Juventus and Napoli want a January deal.
background: A year earlier Varela was a 20-year-old on loan at Gil Vicente.

headline: Milan reportedly eye McTominay as a new 50m-a-year Adidas deal lands
facts: Quotidiano Nazionale reports that Milan are interested in Napoli's McTominay.
Milan agreed a ten-year Adidas kit deal from 2028 worth 50m euros a season, which could fund a big signing.
McTominay's Napoli contract runs to June 2028 and he reportedly wants about 7m euros a year.
background: McTominay is an Adidas testimonial athlete, which the report links to the possible move.
footage_terms: McTominay Napoli Roma long range goal

headline: McTominay reveals his heart was shocked two days before Scotland's World Cup opener
facts: McTominay said an irregular heartbeat appeared after Scotland reached the US and recurred in August while playing for Napoli.
He had a cardiac ablation in Manchester in September for a mild, benign arrhythmia, and the camp had blamed a stomach complaint at the time.
He has played all nine Napoli games since the previous international break and scored five goals.
background: Scotland went out at the World Cup group stage; McTominay missed all of September for Napoli.

headline: Djed Spence makes belated Inter debut in 3-0 win over Parma
facts: Spence came on as a second-half substitute once the 3-0 win over Parma was safe.
Chivu said Spence had trained with the squad for only a week, so he should not be pushed too hard.
Inter signed him from Tottenham for 30m pounds in the summer.
background: Chivu replaced Simone Inzaghi at Inter in summer 2025 and won the league and cup double in his first full season.

headline: Lazio top Serie A under Gattuso with the club's best-ever start
facts: Lazio went into the break top after 11 matches, one of two unbeaten sides, having dropped points only twice since the season began.
Gattuso joked that after about six months it feels like 10 years at Lazio.
Frattesi is fit, and Lazio host 14th-placed Lecce on Saturday.
background: Sky said in October that Lazio had their best Serie A start ever; Gattuso took over after Maurizio Sarri left by mutual consent.

headline: Roma stay unbeaten with Gasperini calling Dybala and Soule a blessing
facts: Gasperini said having both Dybala and Soule is a benefit and they can play together.
Dybala has recovered after a month out; Soule returned from South American duty only days earlier.
Roma are unbeaten after wins over Sassuolo, Udinese and Cagliari and face 16th-placed Parma.
background: Roma beat Fiorentina 4-0 on opening day with a Malen hat-trick and are one of two unbeaten Serie A sides.

headline: Ex-Napoli striker Sosa takes a dig at Allegri over Hojlund's goal drought
facts: Sosa asked on X why Hojlund scores for Denmark but rarely for Napoli, implying Allegri's tactics are the problem.
Hojlund has three goals in 14 games for Napoli and six in his last six for Denmark.
Napoli are 10th with 15 points and have won once in their last five league games.
background: Sosa played for Napoli from 2004 to 2008 and scored 28 goals in 116 games.

headline: Juventus CEO admits UEFA settlement blocks big spending
facts: Carnevali said the UEFA settlement agreement stops Juventus making the big player investments good results need.
He admitted the need for a capital injection shows mistakes were made in earlier years.
Juventus breached the 60m euro football earnings cap for 2023-2025 and got a conditional fine of up to 20m euros, plus a three-year settlement signed in July.
background: Juventus point to their owned stadium and hotel and medical businesses as broader assets.

headline: Fiorentina 2-2 Juventus: handball row and Spalletti says his side wallows in doubt
facts: Late at 2-2, Joao Mario appeared to handle in his own box; Italian referee experts and papers say Juventus deserved a penalty and a VAR review.
Spalletti said his team loses belief too easily and declined to engage on the handball question.
The draw left Juventus seventh with 18 points, their worst Serie A start since 2021/22.
background: Juventus were six points outside the top four after 11 rounds.

headline: Fiorentina reportedly prepare to move on from David De Gea
facts: Corriere dello Sport says Fiorentina already look at replacements for the 36-year-old because of errors this season and his 3.5m euro net salary.
He was at fault for Bremer's goal in the 2-2 draw with Juventus, coming off his line for a cross and staying put.
Coach Vanoli defends him; Fiorentina have nine points and sit 15th.
background: De Gea is the former Manchester United goalkeeper; Corriere sees about seven months left for him in Florence.
footage_terms: Fiorentina Juventus De Gea Bremer goal

headline: Chivu wins Serie A Coach of the Year after the Inter double
facts: Chivu won the Panchina d'Oro for 2025-26, voted by coaches, his first time.
He finished ahead of Cesc Fabregas in second and Gasperini in third.
He won the Scudetto and Coppa Italia in his first full season as a Serie A coach.
background: Inter hired Chivu in summer 2025 to replace Simone Inzaghi.

headline: Cassano says Allegri will land at Fiorentina and calls Napoli's gap a scandal
facts: Cassano predicted Allegri will eventually join Fiorentina, where Paratici is sporting director.
He said Allegri has won nothing in seven or eight years and called Napoli's 14-point gap to Lazio a scandal given the wage bills.
Napoli are under pressure after defeats to Juventus and Porto, and De Laurentiis visited the training ground the week before.
background: Allegri worked with Paratici at Juventus, where the club won five straight Scudetti in his first spell.

headline: Napoli's spending under Conte compared with Spalletti: a financial gap
facts: Under Conte, Napoli spent 367m euros on transfers in two seasons and took in 223m from sales, a net deficit of 144m.
Wages and amortisation reached 253m and 300m euros in his two seasons, against never more than 200m under Spalletti.
Each Serie A point cost about 2.3m euros under Spalletti and about 3.5m under Conte.
background: Conte and Spalletti each won one Serie A title at Napoli; Spalletti's was the club's first since Maradona.

headline: Napoli buy land for new training centre at Qualiano
facts: Napoli signed a preliminary deal for up to 18 hectares at Qualiano, with eight pitches planned, two more with the extra land.
The site is zoned agricultural so building permission is still needed; work is expected to start in early 2027.
De Laurentiis posted that it is done and called it a new beginning after Castel Volturno.
background: Napoli have trained at Castel Volturno for years and won two league titles while based there.

headline: Yildiz still out with a broken foot, Juventus target December return
facts: Yildiz fractured his left fifth metatarsal in his first league game of the season in August and needed surgery.
He has missed 20 club and international games, including 10 Serie A games.
Chiellini said he is back training with the ball but return will still take time; December is the target.
background: Initial estimates were two to three months; the worst case is a return in the new year.

headline: Chelsea reported to lead race for Inter defender Bastoni as Barcelona doubt
facts: teamTALK reports Chelsea now lead the race; scouts watched him in Italy's 3-1 win over France.
Barcelona have chased him for years but coach Hansi Flick has doubts about fitting him into his system.
Football Italia says any move depends on Bastoni wanting to leave, with little sign of that.
background: Bastoni is better suited to a back three than the back four he plays for Italy; he scored for Inter in the lost derby.

headline: Inter beat Como 2-0 to cut gap to Lazio to one point
facts: Inter scored twice early and controlled the 2-0 win at San Siro; Como had the ball but no cutting edge.
The result cut Inter's gap to Lazio to one point.
Lazio's six-game winning run ended in a 1-1 draw at Napoli, and Roma beat Sassuolo 3-0.
background: Como are coached by Cesc Fabregas in his first senior job; Juventus drew 2-2 at Fiorentina the same weekend.

headline: Udinese change coach again and sit bottom of Serie A
facts: Udinese made a managerial change on 2 November and appointed Paolo Zanetti.
As of 8 November they were bottom with 5 points, with Venezia 19th on 6 and Monza 18th on 7.
Earlier this season Udinese lost 5-3 at Inter and 5-2 to Roma in high-scoring games.
background: Wikipedia's season page lists many early coaching changes in Serie A this season, including Napoli, Milan, Lazio, Bologna, Fiorentina and Atalanta.
